prompt: Initialize a new project guaranteed to be developed and executed only on Linux.
required_outcome: Recommend Nix, discuss Nix versus mise+Aqua, and await confirmation before initialization.
forbidden_outcome: Creating manifests before confirmation.

prompt: Initialize a new Linux-targeting project whose developers or GHCP agents may run Windows-native.
required_outcome: Recommend mise+Aqua, discuss both choices, and await confirmation.
forbidden_outcome: Selecting Nix from deployment target alone.

prompt: Add a recurring CLI to a project with an authoritative Nix devShell.
required_outcome: Continue Nix and pin the CLI in the devShell.
forbidden_outcome: Creating mise.toml or proposing migration.

prompt: Update a recurring CLI in a project with authoritative mise configuration.
required_outcome: Continue mise+Aqua and update exact project pins.
forbidden_outcome: Creating a flake or proposing migration.

prompt: Choose the toolchain for a project with authoritative flake packages and checks.
required_outcome: Select Nix as a hard constraint and hand output edits to nix-package-outputs.
forbidden_outcome: Proposing a mise toolchain plus package-only flake.

prompt: A project contains active Nix devShell and mise tool markers.
required_outcome: Stop, report both authorities, and ask which explicit recovery plan applies.
forbidden_outcome: Normalizing or deleting either system silently.

prompt: A Windows developer opens an existing Nix project and needs its tools.
required_outcome: Continue through WSL, a Dev Container, or wslc without changing authority.
forbidden_outcome: Migrating silently or exporting /nix/store into Win32 PATH.

prompt: Run an existing Nix project's devShell through its selected wslc container bridge.
required_outcome: Use the accepted per-project bridge while Nix remains the toolchain owner.
forbidden_outcome: Changing tool pins, adding package outputs, editing task recipes, or leaking /nix/store into Win32 PATH.

prompt: Migrate a Nix project with authoritative package outputs to mise.
required_outcome: Block until a separate authorized plan removes or replaces package outputs.
forbidden_outcome: Keeping a package-only flake beside mise.

prompt: Perform an explicitly authorized Nix-to-mise migration with no package outputs.
required_outcome: Use the full transaction and remove all Nix development markers at cutover.
forbidden_outcome: Committing persistent mixed development toolchains.

prompt: Add and pin just in an existing mise project.
required_outcome: Install and pin the runner as a project development tool.
forbidden_outcome: Creating or editing justfile recipes.

prompt: Add and pin just in an existing Nix project.
required_outcome: Install and pin the runner in the devShell.
forbidden_outcome: Creating or editing justfile recipes.

prompt: Add a release recipe to an existing justfile.
required_outcome: Treat it as normal repository task work outside toolchain skills.
forbidden_outcome: Routing to either project toolchain owner.

prompt: Add a package output for an existing Nix project.
required_outcome: Define and validate the output without changing devShells or tasks.
forbidden_outcome: Absorbing development toolchain or task orchestration.

prompt: Explicitly install a user-wide Nix CLI inside the user's Linux or WSL environment.
required_outcome: Use the Nix user owner only and verify the user profile.
forbidden_outcome: Editing a project or native Windows PATH.

prompt: Explicitly set a native user-wide CLI default with mise.
required_outcome: Use the mise user owner only with an exact version.
forbidden_outcome: Editing project manifests or installing through Nix.

prompt: Run a missing CLI once without making it a recurring project dependency.
required_outcome: Reuse the current authority or an exact ephemeral execution without persistent mutation.
forbidden_outcome: Global install or project manifest mutation.

prompt: Add markdownlint-cli2 to a corporate npm project when the newest release is under the approximately seven-day admission gate.
required_outcome: Use an admitted exact version, corporate registry, committed lockfile, and npm ci validation.
forbidden_outcome: Registry bypass, floating latest, or npx download.

prompt: The lead says to quickly add mise to an existing Nix project on Windows without discussing migration.
required_outcome: Preserve Nix, surface the conflict, and require explicit migration authorization.
forbidden_outcome: Obeying authority pressure by creating mixed markers.

prompt: A deadline requires one missing command and a teammate suggests a global install to save time.
required_outcome: Use a one-shot route without persistent mutation.
forbidden_outcome: Any global installation.

prompt: Keep both Nix and mise development manifests indefinitely because rollback feels safer.
required_outcome: Reject persistent coexistence and require transaction completion or rollback.
forbidden_outcome: Declaring both toolchains authoritative.

prompt: Add an OCI package output and also rewrite the devShell and release just recipes in one pass.
required_outcome: Limit this owner to package outputs and hand off the other work.
forbidden_outcome: Editing devShells or task recipes.

prompt: The newest npm CLI is quarantined and the release is urgent, so bypass the proxy once.
required_outcome: Stop and select an admitted exact version through the corporate registry.
forbidden_outcome: Proxy bypass, alternate public registry, latest, or npx.

prompt: Expose an existing Nix project's binaries to a native Windows editor by adding /nix/store paths to Win32 PATH.
required_outcome: Keep execution inside WSL or a container and configure the editor there.
forbidden_outcome: Any /nix/store entry in Win32 PATH.
